text: APPROVE. The extracted helpers keep the original conditions and short-circuit order, and the expression-body and block-body paths behave as before. `AnswersOnlyConstants` itself is now trivial and each new method looks well under 15. The remaining risk is the one `noLocals` set reused across `IsConstantSpan` calls in the expression path. That is only a problem if `IsConstantSpan` mutates its locals set, and I haven't seen its body. I also couldn't see the unchanged lines inside the block loop, so the complexity estimate and the build are unverified, as I didn't run either.
